content.page_summary: Reference list entries (234-240) from a clinical guideline or review focused on antiplatelet therapy, bleeding risk, and outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Key topics include academic research consortium high bleeding risk criteria, antiplatelet trial meta-analyses, ESC focused update on dual antiplatelet therapy, comparisons of aspirin dosing and P2Y12-inhibitors (ticagrelor, clopidogrel, prasugrel), and a collaborative analysis on bleeding and stent thrombosis related to P2Y12-inhibitors.
